description_en: Queries statistics on the request volume for all subdomains of a specified domain name
description_zh: 查询指定域名下的全部子域名的请求量统计
name: DescribeRecordResolveStatisticsSummary

parameters.help_en:
The type of the domain name. This parameter is not case-sensitive. Valid values:

PUBLIC: an authoritative domain name (default)

CACHE: an authoritative proxy domain name
parameters.help_zh:
域名类型，大小写不敏感。取值：

PUBLIC：权威托管域名（默认值）

CACHE：权威代理域名
parameters.name: domain_type

parameters.help_en: The keyword. This parameter is used with SearchMode
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The search mode of the keyword. Valid values:

LIKE: fuzzy search (default)

EXACT: exact match
parameters.help_zh:
关键词的搜索模式。取值：

模糊搜索（默认）：LIKE

精确搜索：EXACT
parameters.name: search_mode

parameters.help_en:
The sorting direction. Valid values:

DESC: descending order (default)

ASC: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值：

递减（默认）：DESC

递增：ASC
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The resolution count threshold. This parameter lets you query subdomains based on their resolution counts.

If you do not specify this parameter, data for subdomains with a resolution count greater than 0 is returned.

If you specify a value less than 0, all data is returned.

If you specify 0, data for subdomains with a resolution count of 0 is returned.

If you specify a value greater than 0, data for subdomains with a resolution count less than or equal to the specified value is returned
parameters.help_zh:
解析量查询条件，可用于查询不同解析量类别的子域名列表及子域名解析量数据。

不传：查询解析量非0的数据

传小于0的值：查询所有数据

传0：查询无解析量的数据

传大于0的值：查询解析量不超过该值的子域名
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: The start date. Specify the date in the YYYY-MM-DD format. For example: 2023-03-01
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date. Specify the date in the YYYY-MM-DD format. For example: 2023-03-13
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 1000 and the minimum value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值1000，最小值为1
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The language. Valid values: zh, en, and ja
parameters.name: lang

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. The maximum value is 500. The default value is 20
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值500，默认为20

DomainType.description_en:
The type of the domain name. This parameter is not case-sensitive. Valid values:

PUBLIC: an authoritative domain name (default)

CACHE: an authoritative proxy domain name
DomainType.description_zh:
域名类型，大小写不敏感。取值：

PUBLIC：权威托管域名（默认值）

CACHE：权威代理域名

TotalItems.description_en: The total number of entries returned

TotalPages.description_en: The total number of pages returned
